title: "Operation SOFT TOUCH Overflights, August 1957" – U-2 routes over USSR and China
description: Map titled "Operation SOFT TOUCH Overflights, August 1957" showing U-2 flight routes fanning out from Pakistan (Lahore/Peshawar area) over Soviet Central Asia, Siberia and western China. A legend lists Missions 4035 (5 August), 4036 (8 August), 4039 (12 August), 4045 and 4048 (21 August), 4049, 4050 and 4051 (22 August), and 4058 (28 August). Marked sites include Tyuratam, Semipalatinsk, Novosibirsk-area cities, Tomsk, Krasnoyarsk, Lake Balkhash and Lhasa; marked "Secret NOFORN" with handwritten page number "136."
